notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
smbclient -L lists all available shares on the target SMB server. -N flag skips password prompt for null session. Returns share names, types (Disk/IPC/Printer), and comments.

=== CHAINING ===
List shares → identify non-default shares (ADMIN$, C$, IPC$ are default; custom shares are more interesting) → check permissions with smbmap → connect to accessible shares with smbclient.

=== IPC$ ===
IPC$ (Inter-Process Communication) share enables null session RPC queries even when named shares require auth. rpcclient uses IPC$ for user/group enumeration.
